title: Dance dates with Morton and Wickliffe's Milwaukee engagement
summary: Levy played dance dates with Morton but no theaters. He also recalls Blue Mound Road in Milwaukee with Wickliffe.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Uh-huh, uh-huh. So, I was. Did you play any theater jobs? Oh, yes. I was. Did you play Milwaukee? Yes, I played Milwaukee. I was at Blue Mound Road with Wickliffe's Band. We had, we were spoiled at the.
I'm thinking of Jelly playing the Riverside Theater. No, I didn't play the Riverside.
I didn't play any theater with Jelly. I only played the Dance Dates. Dance Dates. I played the Dance Dates with Jelly.

Did you play Heron, Illinois? Yes. Yes, played Heron, Illinois with Jelly. Well, this is a band that we never found anybody who played Heron, Illinois with Jelly, and yet there's records that he worked for MCA. Yes, yes. Now, you said Barnes. Do you remember anybody else?
